lessons_used: Reordering the onboarding flow and adding preset fallback choices were helpful.
Interactive screen redesigns and desktop hint notifications hurt performance.
Copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, and background notifications showed no clear effect.
Predictions for flow reordering and fallback choices were accurate or slightly underestimated.
Predictions were consistently too high for copy changes, guidelines, hint notifications, layout tweaks, and visual redesigns.

candidates.title: Pet Personality Selection Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet personality selection screen into the adoption flow before sign-in to let users choose behavioral traits for their pet.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 65.6% and a high mean duration of 1017s; structured trait selection engages users early and clarifies pet behavior.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_personality_select']

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Mode Selector on Home Welcome
candidates.change: Redesign the home welcome screen by replacing the static intro with interactive companion mode choice cards (e.g. Quiet, Playful).
candidates.why: Multiple support emails report confusion around controlling and interacting with pets on the desktop, while the finish step drops off at 64.8%.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Account Recovery Warning Checklist on Sign-In
candidates.change: Add an account persistence checklist component to the sign-in screen highlighting email matching to prevent duplicate resets.
candidates.why: Support mail highlighted 8 cases of pets missing or reset after users signed in again with a different account.

components.text: Sign in with your original account to maintain pet data

guard.reason: Adding account persistence checklist text to the sign-in screen is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Supported by support emails and new flow/reorder changes perform strongly in past tests.

candidates.title: Story Teaser Prioritization Flow Reorder
candidates.change: Reorder onboarding screens to highlight story narrative choices prior to path selection.
candidates.why: The initial path selection drops off at 76.2% with a mean time of 514s; leading with narrative context reduces decision friction.

guard.reason: Reordering/updating story screen properties while preserving all required onboarding steps is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Reordering onboarding flow previously delivered high positive lift on early drop-off steps.

candidates.title: Estimated Generation Time Counter on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Display explicit progress bars and estimated generation time counters on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The home waiting stage takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to abandonment before completion.

guard.reason: Showing estimated generation time during a real generation wait is permitted under rule 5 and rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Wait info progress updates previously yielded +3.9% lift on the home screen stage.

candidates.title: Pet Naming Encouragement Badge on Certificate
candidates.change: Add an official pet adoption badge component to the adoption certificate screen to encourage users to finalize naming.
candidates.why: Adoption completion is 65.6%; adding visual identity rewards motivates users through the final step of adoption.

guard.reason: Adding a badge component to the adoption certificate screen preserves existing jobs and is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step, but visual add-ons show limited proven impact.

candidates.title: Desktop Docking System Tray Hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent system tray control hint text on the home introduction screen.
candidates.why: Users wrote to support asking how to control, hide, or interact with their pet after completing onboarding.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click your pet or use the system tray icon anytime to manage pet settings and hide options.

guard.reason: Adding system tray hint text to the home intro overlay is permitted within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Support mentions issue, but hint and notification changes consistently hurt metrics.

candidates.title: Path Selection Outcome Headline Clarification
candidates.change: Rewrite choose_path screen headline and body text to clearly distinguish fast preset pets from custom photo pets.
candidates.why: Choose path mean duration is 514s, showing users take excessive time evaluating options without clear expectations.

choose_path.headline: Select Ready-Made or Custom Pet
choose_path.body: Pick an instant pre-made pet companion or upload photos to generate a unique custom companion.

guard.reason: Clarifying path selection text preserves both adopt and make options without breaking pricing or design rules.

candidates.score_note: Copy changes have repeatedly shown zero or negative impact.

candidates.title: Photo Processing Readiness Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Enable desktop readiness notifications during photo processing on the upload_photos screen.
candidates.why: Custom pet generation can stall or take long (adoption mean time 1017s), resulting in dropped sessions or reported generation failures.

guard.reason: Enabling readiness notifications during photo processing is explicitly allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: High potential step drop-off, but desktop notifications historically degraded performance.

candidates.title: Compact Stage Layout for Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Switch the waiting screen layout to 'compact' to streamline visual focus during backend generation.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean duration is 2336s; a clean compact view reduces perceived UI complexity while waiting.

guard.reason: Changing the layout of the waiting screen to compact is a valid onboarding layout change.

candidates.score_note: Layout tweaks and visual adjustments showed no clear positive effect.
